newsitem.title: UK: Sinn Fein says republican leader Adams held.
newsitem.headline: Sinn Fein says republican leader Adams held.

text.p: Gerry Adams, president of the Irish Republican Army's political wing Sinn Fein, has been detained by security forces in Northern Ireland, Sinn Fein said in a statement on Thursday.
Party colleague Gerry Kelly was also held, according to a report carried by Britain's Press Association news agency.
Sinn Fein said the pair were held near Banbridge in Northern Ireland's County Down, south of Belfast.
The party said Adams and Kelly were held and "generally harassed" by British army soldiers.
Sinn Fein said the two men were on their way back to Belfast from a party meeting.
Police made no immediate comment about the detention.
